senses.gloss: f. (√אז, v. אֲזַד; cmp. קָצֶה) a piece, part, uzya, a market term for a certain portion (quarter &c.) of meat.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 29a:1">Bets. 29ᵃ</cite> in Pumb. they call it <he>א׳ ופלגא א׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ופלגו א׳</he> corr. acc.; Var. <cite ref="A00784"><he>אוסיא</he></cite>) an uzya and half an uzya.
